code: library(synthcheck)  # Honesty-Humility, Canada: real people and four language models h <- hexaco_items$item[hexaco_items$trait == "H"] rev_items <- intersect(h, hexaco_items$item[hexaco_items$reverse]) keyed <- function(d) { d <- d[h]; d[rev_items] <- 8 - d[rev_items]; d }  real <- keyed(hexaco_real[hexaco_real$country == "Canada", ]) ca <- hexaco_llm[hexaco_llm$country == "Canada" & hexaco_llm$attempt <= 4, ] synthetic <- lapply(split(ca, ca$model, drop = TRUE),                     function(m) lapply(split(m, m$attempt), keyed))  cov <- synthetic_coverage(synthetic, real, cor = "pearson") cov gg_coverage(cov)

code: # made-up example: three "models" whose respondents differ from the # real population in different ways, five attempts each set.seed(1) a <- matrix(rlnorm(12, 0.2, 0.3)); d <- matrix(rnorm(12)) real <- as.data.frame(mirt::simdata(a, d, 1000, itemtype = "dich")) llm <- function(mu, s) lapply(1:5, function(i) as.data.frame(   mirt::simdata(a, d, 200, itemtype = "dich", Theta = matrix(rnorm(200, mu, s))))) cov <- synthetic_coverage(list("LLM A" = llm(0.8, 0.7), "LLM B" = llm(0, 0.4),                                "LLM C" = llm(-0.6, 0.9)), real) cov #> <sc_coverage> 3 model(s), 12 item(s), coverage of real total-score slices (EXPERIMENTAL) #>       model attempts overlap_overall overlap_lowest overlap_highest #>       LLM A        5             67%            65%             69% #>       LLM B        5             74%            70%             77% #>       LLM C        5             76%            72%             81% #>  Best Blend        2             93%            92%             93% #>  structure_overall structure_lowest structure_highest #>                81%              78%               86% #>                70%              68%               72% #>                89%              87%               90% #>                90%              90%               91% #>  #> Best Blend: 35% LLM A + 15% LLM B + 50% LLM C (chosen on attempts 1 to 3; its numbers come from attempts 4 to 5) gg_coverage(cov)
